kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جَلْهَم or جُلْهُم • (jalham or julhum) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Middle Persian, equivalent to the well-known Ottoman Turkish جهری (cehri, “buckthorn, shrub of yellowberry”).
s: Ottoman Turkish جهری (cehri, “buckthorn, shrub of yellowberry”)
g: buckthorn or certain species thereof, yellowberry, Persian berry (Rhamnus infectoria, Rhamnus amygdalina, Rhamnus lycioides subsp. oleoides)
